case.summary: This case (HHG-019) was triggered by a real-time risk score of 0.90 on transaction 3503878 ($99.92) on card C07987-K2. The transaction was an online purchase on 2016-12-01 using a new device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720'. Investigation revealed this device profile was shared among 5 cards (including C07987-K2, C01104-K2, C01983-K1, C06224-K2, and C11309-K1) between 2016-11-29 and 2016-12-04, totaling $500.00. Based on prior confirmed fraud cases like CC-2878 and CC-3438, this fits the card-not-present new device fraud pattern, leading to the card being blocked and a SAR being filed.

sar.narrative: On 2016-12-01, cardholder C07987 experienced an unauthorized online transaction of $99.92 on card C07987-K2. The transaction (ID 3503878) originated from a device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720' which was completely new to the cardholder's account. A subsequent network analysis revealed that this exact device profile was used to conduct transactions across 5 different cardholders between 2016-11-29 and 2016-12-04, totaling $500.00. The connected cards involved in this activity include C01104-K2, C01983-K1, C06224-K2, and C11309-K1. This coordinated use of a single new device profile across multiple unrelated accounts indicates a systematic card-not-present fraud ring. Similar prior cases, such as CC-2878 and CC-3438, confirm this pattern as highly indicative of compromise. Therefore, a Suspicious Activity Report is being filed to document this coordinated abuse, and card C07987-K2 has been blocked to prevent further exposure.

stop_reason: The card was blocked and a report filed under Policy R2 and R6 due to the transaction's connection to a shared device profile and other cards' fraud.
